"""
Legacy ORA router for founding-inline operations.

This module provides endpoints related to inline founding document
generation and retrieval. It is preserved from the legacy ORA codebase
for reference and backward compatibility.
"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/founding-inline",
    tags=["founding-inline"],
)


class FoundingInlineRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request model for generating an inline founding document."""
    project_name: str = Field(..., description="Name of the project")
    description: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Project description")
    members: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of member identifiers")


class FoundingInlineResponse(BaseModel):
    """Response model for an inline founding document."""
    id: str
    project_name: str
    description: Optional[str]
    members: List[str]
    status: str


@router.post("/", response_model=FoundingInlineResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_founding_inline(request: FoundingInlineRequest):
    """Create a new inline founding document."""
    logger.info("Creating inline founding document for project: %s", request.project_name)
    return FoundingInlineResponse(
        id="inline-founding-placeholder",
        project_name=request.project_name,
        description=request.description,
        members=request.members,
        status="created",
    )


@router.get("/{founding_id}", response_model=FoundingInlineResponse)
async def get_founding_inline(founding_id: str):
    """Retrieve an inline founding document by ID."""
    logger.info("Retrieving inline founding document: %s", founding_id)
    if not founding_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Founding document not found",
        )
    return FoundingInlineResponse(
        id=founding_id,
        project_name="Unknown",
        description=None,
        members=[],
        status="retrieved",
    )

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/store-settings",
    tags=["store-settings"],
)


class StoreSettings(BaseModel):
    store_name: Optional[str] = None
    currency: Optional[str] = "USD"
    timezone: Optional[str] = "UTC"
    tax_rate: Optional[float] = 0.0
    is_active: bool = True


# In-memory placeholder store settings
_store_settings: StoreSettings = StoreSettings(
    store_name="Default Store",
    currency="USD",
    timezone="UTC",
    tax_rate=0.0,
    is_active=True,
)


@router.get("/", response_model=StoreSettings)
async def get_store_settings():
    """Retrieve the current store settings."""
    return _store_settings


@router.put("/", response_model=StoreSettings)
async def update_store_settings(settings: StoreSettings):
    """Update the store settings."""
    global _store_settings
    _store_settings = settings
    return _store_settings


@router.patch("/", response_model=StoreSettings)
async def patch_store_settings(settings: StoreSettings):
    """Partially update the store settings."""
    global _store_settings
    update_data = settings.dict(exclude_unset=True)
    current_data = _store_settings.dict()
    current_data.update(update_data)
    _store_settings = StoreSettings(**current_data)
    return _store_settings


@router.post("/reset", response_model=StoreSettings)
async def reset_store_settings():
    """Reset store settings to defaults."""
    global _store_settings
    _store_settings = StoreSettings(
        store_name="Default Store",
        currency="USD",
        timezone="UTC",
        tax_rate=0.0,
        is_active=True,
    )
    return _store_settings

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List, Optional

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/aurem-rules",
    tags=["aurem-rules"],
)


class Rule(BaseModel):
    id: Optional[int] = None
    name: str
    description: Optional[str] = None
    enabled: bool = True
    condition: Optional[str] = None
    action: Optional[str] = None


# In-memory store for demonstration purposes
_rules: List[Rule] = []
_next_id = 1


@router.get("/", response_model=List[Rule])
async def list_rules():
    """Return all configured Aurem rules."""
    return _rules


@router.post("/", response_model=Rule, status_code=201)
async def create_rule(rule: Rule):
    """Create a new Aurem rule."""
    global _next_id
    rule.id = _next_id
    _next_id += 1
    _rules.append(rule)
    return rule


@router.get("/{rule_id}", response_model=Rule)
async def get_rule(rule_id: int):
    """Return a single Aurem rule by ID."""
    for r in _rules:
        if r.id == rule_id:
            return r
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Rule not found")


@router.put("/{rule_id}", response_model=Rule)
async def update_rule(rule_id: int, updated: Rule):
    """Update an existing Aurem rule."""
    for i, r in enumerate(_rules):
        if r.id == rule_id:
            updated.id = rule_id
            _rules[i] = updated
            return updated
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Rule not found")


@router.delete("/{rule_id}", status_code=204)
async def delete_rule(rule_id: int):
    """Delete an Aurem rule by ID."""
    for i, r in enumerate(_rules):
        if r.id == rule_id:
            _rules.pop(i)
            return
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Rule not found")

    category: str

class AnomalyRequest(BaseModel):
